svg.title: Variable-length causal attention with three documents and four CP ranks
svg.desc: Three packed documents contain 4000, 8000, and 12000 tokens. Each is split into eight equal chunks assigned to ranks 0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 2, 1, 0. Attention is causal within each document, with no cross-document attention. The communication panel shows rank 2 receiving 3000 KV tokens from rank 0, 3000 from rank 1, and 6000 from rank 3, while keeping 6000 local KV tokens. It requests token ranges [0, 3000), [4000, 10000), and [12000, 21000).
svg.text: 3 documents · 4 CP ranks · selective KV group_cast
Each document is split into 8 equal chunks.
Three peers supply the requested remote KV ranges.
Local zigzag ownership within each document
Mask color: Q-compute rank. Axis bands: Q/KV owner.
24,000 packed tokens; 6,000 owned per rank. Token IDs are global, and ranges are half-open.
The attention kernel enforces document boundaries and causality; group_cast moves only requested KV tokens.
